events.title: Telegram
events.text:
A Florida fishing charter hauled a Shahed-136 clone drone out of the Gulf of Mexico near Eglin Air Force Base.
Eglin confirmed it lost a drone during testing but wouldn't confirm it was the same one.
The recovered drone matches the FLM-136/LUCAS — America's own reverse-engineered copy of Iran's Shahed-136, which costs ~$35K per unit and saw first combat use striking Iran.
It was missing its engine, propeller, and nose cone from the water impact.
[SOURCE](https://www.twz.com/air/shahed-136-clone-found-by-florida-fisherman-eglin-afb-admits-it-lost-a-drone)

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
🇮🇶 Iraqi PMF foils ISIS infiltration attempt near Lake Tharthar
The Popular Mobilization Forces have thwarted an infiltration attempt by ISIS elements in the Lake Tharthar area, east of Anbar province — targeting a PMF position.
Forces seized a boat, weapons, and food supplies — the remaining militants fled after suffering losses.
📌 The same area was targeted by an attack on electricity towers just days ago, local media reported.
The Tharthar basin has long served as an ISIS hiding ground and transit corridor between Anbar and Salaheddin provinces. The foiled infiltration — and the recovery of a boat — suggests the group is attempting to re-establish movement routes through the lake's marshes and islands.

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
😱 Trump furious as control slips — report
President Trump is increasingly frustrated by political and legal setbacks and believes too few allies are publicly defending his record, according to the Wall Street Journal.
His frustrations intensified after he was shown negative television coverage of his own administration — hours later, he banned MS NOW, CNN, and Politico from the White House.
What's driving the anger:
🔴 Falling approval ratings and concerns about Republican performance in the midterms
🔴 Voter frustration over the Iran war and higher energy prices
🔴 Complaints that prominent figures haven't thanked him for his attempted overhaul of the Kennedy Center
🔴 A perception that allies aren't defending his second-term record publicly
His administration has been hunting for foreign-policy victories to tout before the November midterms — and the past few weeks show the pattern clearly:
🔶 A Greenland deal granting [permanent US security control,](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74808) with a military deployment to follow — more a political stunt than a real strategic change
🔶 Repeated claims of a destroyed Iran — while Iran's blockade still holds, the strait stays shut, and [Iran sets terms for talks](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74836)
🔶 Growing anxiety over the Houthi advance — Trump [cut short his Camp David stay](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74837) to seek ways to support a Saudi ally that's losing the war
Nothing is stopping the situation from growing more desperate for the Trump administration and his party. As fuel prices hit record highs and the image of US military power weakens abroad, the president's approval ratings follow the same trend. The spiral is tightening — and he knows it.
👍 [Substack](https://geopoliticsprime.substack.com/) | [Chat](https://t.me/+HLrnOk92f31mYzIy) |

🚨 Iran shoots down Israeli drone over Strait of Hormuz
Iran's Armed Forces are at a high state of alert after air defenses shot down an advanced Orbiter reconnaissance drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian media released images of the remains of the downed aircraft.
The Orbiter is an advanced Israeli-made reconnaissance platform — its loss over the strait is a significant intelligence blow.

🔥 Saudi Arabia resumes shelling and airstrikes on northern Yemen — 4 killed
Saudi artillery and warplanes have resumed targeting populated areas in northern Yemen, according to Houthi-run Al-Masirah TV, with strikes hitting border districts and telecommunications infrastructure.
🔴 Sa'adah — Saudi artillery shelling targeted several villages in the border district of Al-Dhahir, with dozens of missiles and shells hitting the districts of Al-Dhahir and Haydan
🔴 Al-Jawf — Saudi warplanes launched two airstrikes on the Al-Matoun complex, striking telecommunications towers along Yemen's northern border
🔴 Four workers killed, three injured in the strikes on telecom facilities, per Al-Masirah
